findings.claim: `test:a11y` uses POSIX shell syntax, so the required npm script is not portable to all developer machines.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria require scripts including `test:a11y` and the spec says the harness should run identically on any developer machine; the added script is `node e2e/support/a11y-report.mjs --clean && playwright test e2e/a11y.spec.ts; status=$?; node e2e/support/a11y-report.mjs; exit $status`, which relies on `status=$?` and `exit $status` shell syntax not supported by Windows `cmd.exe` npm scripts.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the orchestration into a Node script that spawns Playwright, captures the exit code, runs the report merger, and exits with the captured code.
